solver: catering.methods.classical.solve_qubo: seeded Metropolis SA, cold random bits, no repair, temperature scaled by the bundle's max |coefficient| (unchanged repo code)
bundles: 16 frozen sources x {source, local, local-uw, local-m8, local-uw-m8} from bundles/build-report.json
metrics: best valid (U,W,B,R) (lexicographic; post-hoc B/R tie-break for local-uw)
valid samples at or better than the frozen CP reference tuple
comparability: tuples across variants of one source; never raw energies
limitations: one seed, one CPU, one SA schedule; SA is a control, not VeloxQ. Results do not predict VeloxQ behaviour without service runs
